title: Megan Thee Stallion Flexes Her Rapping Chops & Hip Muscles in Limp Bizkit-Sampling ‘Thin Ice’ Video
summary: Tina Snow is back with another Tina Tuesday Freestyle.
contentText:
It’s Tuesday (Oct. 20), which means Megan Thee Stallion has transformed into her Tina Snow alter ego and released another installment of her Tina Tuesday Freestyle series with “Thin Ice.”

Related

Megan Thee Stallion Serves ‘Body’ During ‘Dream Come True’ 2026 Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show Performance

Megan Thee Stallion Says a Doechii Collaboration Is On Her ‘Album Wish List’ for ‘Act III’

Megan Thee Stallion Announces Return of Hottieween in Las Vegas: ‘Thee Circus Is Coming’

Produced by Buddah Bless, Megan brought the sex appeal and ferocious raps to the table for “Thin Ice,” which features a lift from a sample of Limp Bizkit’s “Break Stuff” off the band’s sophomore album, 1999’s Significant Other . The song kicks off with Fred Durst’s slowed down vocals declaring, “I think you better quit talkin’ that s–t/ It’s all about the he says, she says bulls–t” before the beat drops. “B—h, they call me Tina Montana/ I come in the club it’s snowing,” she later raps.

The spicy clip finds Meg stunting in her signature platinum hair and scantily clad black attire, but it’s the twerking-approved bodysuit that steals the show as she bounces around a barren warehouse.

“I’m Black and I’m proud/ The skin James Brown/ The body is smoking, no Black and Mild/ I need me a girlfriend like Toni Childs,” the 31-year-old boasts.

Plenty of Megan’s peers — such as Kehlani , Juicy J and Flo Milli — showed love in her comments section on Instagram. “YOU OUTTA CONTROL,” the “Folded” singer proclaimed. The Three 6 Mafia rapper added: “Talk yo s–t verse killer!”

Tina Snow thrives in the winter, but Megan Thee Stallion is scorching in October. She’s coming off making her Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show runway debut, where she served body and performed her hit of the same name on Sunday (Oct. 18), which fulfilled a childhood dream.

I swear ima b a victoria secret model when I grow up:) #youngandsexy 🙂

— TINA SNOW (@theestallion) June 24, 2011

Megan’s has kept things hot with her Tina Tuesday Freestyle series, as she rapped in a blizzard for the blistering “Is You Cool?” earlier in October. With Meg back to rapping, it could be a sign her anticipated Act III album is on the way, which she’s been teasing. The Grammy-winning rapper’s last album came with  Megan  in 2024, which  debuted at No. 3  on the  Billboard 200  with 64,000 total album-equivalent units, according to Luminate.

The Houston Hottie is also welcoming the return of her Hottieween party, which will ring in spooky season at Zouk nightclub in Las Vegas on Oct. 30.
